expectedIssues: Section title shows the raw translation key home_feed.popular_title instead of translated text
reportedIssues: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated label such as 'Popular near you'. This is user-visible placeholder/debug text in a primary heading.
The favorite (heart) buttons on the two restaurant cards use inconsistent styling — the first has a white/light circular background while the second has a dark circular background.
The 'Fastest near you' carousel's third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped by the screen edge with its title truncated mid-word and no visible affordance that the row scrolls.
The category chip row is cut off at the right edge (a partial chip is visible past 'Healthy'), which can look like a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable row.
The bottom promo/pizza card is abruptly cut by the bottom navigation bar without any visible scroll indicator or bottom content inset.
